text:
Four modes, a base to appear beside, and a ship that answers the controls. The sources describe the controls as three separate things, so they are three beats.
usecase UC-E1-1 "Player chooses one of the four game modes" status=HAVE
ground UC-E1-1 "game mode"
ground UC-E1-1 objective
requires UC-E1-1 S:at_menu
establishes UC-E1-1 S:mode_chosen
includes E1 UC-E1-1
state S:mode_chosen "a mode is chosen and its objective is set"
accept UC-E1-1 "each of the four modes is selectable from the main menu"
accept UC-E1-1 "the objective the mode sets is stated before the round starts"
because UC-E1-1 "the objective differs per mode, so it has to be settled before anything else means anything"
instead UC-E1-1 "one mode with the objective chosen later"
usecase UC-E1-2 "The server places the ship beside its base" status=HAVE
ground UC-E1-2 "space station"
requires UC-E1-2 S:mode_chosen
establishes UC-E1-2 S:ship_placed
includes E1 UC-E1-2
state S:ship_placed "the pilot has a ship in the world, near its base"
accept UC-E1-2 "the pilot appears within sight of the station the sources call their base"
usecase UC-E1-3 "Pilot steers the ship" status=HAVE
ground UC-E1-3 steer
ground UC-E1-3 controls
requires UC-E1-3 S:ship_placed
establishes UC-E1-3 S:can_steer
includes E1 UC-E1-3
state S:can_steer "the ship's heading answers the player"
accept UC-E1-3 "the mouse and the left and right arrow keys both change heading"
because UC-E1-3 "the sources describe two input schemes for the same act, so either alone is incomplete"
instead UC-E1-3 "mouse only, as many browser shooters do"
usecase UC-E1-4 "Pilot accelerates the ship" status=HAVE
ground UC-E1-4 accelerate
requires UC-E1-4 S:can_steer
establishes UC-E1-4 S:can_move
includes E1 UC-E1-4
state S:can_move "the ship moves under the player's control"
accept UC-E1-4 "right-click and the up arrow both accelerate"
usecase UC-E1-5 "Pilot fires the ship's weapon" status=HAVE
ground UC-E1-5 fire
ground UC-E1-5 weapons
requires UC-E1-5 S:can_move
establishes UC-E1-5 S:in_field
includes E1 UC-E1-5
accept UC-E1-5 "left-click and the space bar both fire"
accept UC-E1-5 "a pilot who can steer, move and fire is in the field and needs nothing further to play"

Refused for a compound name. Renaming rather than splitting: weighing size against exposure is one judgement the pilot makes at one moment, not two goals — the objection offers both routes and this is the case it was written for.
usecase UC-E2-1 "Pilot breaks an asteroid apart" status=HAVE
ground UC-E2-1 asteroid
ground UC-E2-1 weapons
requires UC-E2-1 S:in_field
establishes UC-E2-1 S:rock_broken
includes E2 UC-E2-1
state S:rock_broken "an asteroid has been broken"
accept UC-E2-1 "an asteroid takes damage from weapons fire and breaks"
usecase UC-E2-2 "A broken asteroid leaves crystals in the field" status=HAVE
ground UC-E2-2 gem
ground UC-E2-2 asteroid
requires UC-E2-2 S:rock_broken
establishes UC-E2-2 S:gems_loose
includes E2 UC-E2-2
state S:gems_loose "crystals are loose in the field"
accept UC-E2-2 "a broken asteroid leaves crystals where it was"
accept UC-E2-2 "a larger asteroid leaves larger chunks than a smaller one"
usecase UC-E2-3 "Pilot picks up a loose crystal" status=HAVE
ground UC-E2-3 gem
requires UC-E2-3 S:gems_loose
establishes UC-E2-3 S:gems_held
includes E2 UC-E2-3
state S:gems_held "crystals are in the ship's hold"
accept UC-E2-3 "flying over a loose crystal puts it in the hold"
usecase UC-E2-4 "The hold refuses crystals past its ceiling" status=HAVE
ground UC-E2-4 "cargo capacity"
requires UC-E2-4 S:gems_held
establishes UC-E2-4 S:hold_bounded
includes E2 UC-E2-4
state S:hold_bounded "the hold has a known ceiling and enforces it"
accept UC-E2-4 "a pickup that would exceed the ceiling is lost rather than held"
accept UC-E2-4 "a full hold accepts nothing until something leaves it"
because UC-E2-4 "a ceiling is what makes returning to spend a decision rather than a formality"
instead UC-E2-4 "an unbounded hold, which would remove the reason ever to stop mining"
usecase UC-E2-5 "Pilot weighs asteroid size against exposure" status=HAVE
ground UC-E2-5 asteroid
requires UC-E2-5 S:hold_bounded
establishes UC-E2-5 S:mining_has_a_cost
includes E2 UC-E2-5
state S:mining_has_a_cost "the pilot is trading safety for yield"
accept UC-E2-5 "a larger asteroid yields more crystals per unit of damage dealt"
accept UC-E2-5 "a larger asteroid takes longer, leaving the pilot in one place for longer"
because UC-E2-5 "without the size trade-off mining is a chore rather than a choice"
instead UC-E2-5 "every asteroid worth the same, which the sources contradict"
usecase UC-E2-6 "The hold fills" status=HAVE
ground UC-E2-6 "cargo capacity"
ground UC-E2-6 "upgrade cost"
requires UC-E2-6 S:mining_has_a_cost
establishes UC-E2-6 S:cargo_full
includes E2 UC-E2-6
accept UC-E2-6 "the hold reports itself full at the documented capacity for the tier"
accept UC-E2-6 "a full hold is what unlocks both the extra life and the next ship"

A full hold has three destinations in the sources: statistics, an extra life, or the next ship. Taking the next ship hands over an un-upgraded one, which is what makes it a trade rather than a reward.
usecase UC-E3-1 "Pilot spends crystals on one of eight statistics" status=HAVE
ground UC-E3-1 "upgrade categories"
ground UC-E3-1 "upgrade cost"
ground UC-E3-1 "spend gems"
requires UC-E3-1 S:cargo_full
establishes UC-E3-1 S:stat_raised
includes E3 UC-E3-1
state S:stat_raised "at least one statistic is above its base"
accept UC-E3-1 "there are exactly eight categories a crystal can go into"
accept UC-E3-1 "the cost of the next level in a category rises with the level already held"
usecase UC-E3-2 "A raised statistic changes how the ship performs" status=HAVE
ground UC-E3-2 "energy regen"
requires UC-E3-2 S:stat_raised
establishes UC-E3-2 S:ship_better
includes E3 UC-E3-2
accept UC-E3-2 "raising energy regeneration visibly shortens the wait between sustained bursts"
accept UC-E3-2 "a statistic at its base leaves the ship exactly as it was"
usecase UC-E3-3 "Pilot buys an extra life with a full hold" status=HAVE
ground UC-E3-3 "extra life"
requires UC-E3-3 S:cargo_full
establishes UC-E3-3 S:life_banked
includes E3 UC-E3-3
state S:life_banked "the pilot holds a life in reserve"
accept UC-E3-3 "an extra life can only be bought with a full hold"
accept UC-E3-3 "the number of lives that can be held is capped, and the cap depends on the tier"
usecase UC-E3-4 "A full hold offers the next ship in the tree" status=HAVE
ground UC-E3-4 "tier up"
ground UC-E3-4 ship
requires UC-E3-4 S:cargo_full
establishes UC-E3-4 S:tier_offered
includes E3 UC-E3-4
state S:tier_offered "a next ship is on offer"
accept UC-E3-4 "the offer is a choice between two ships, not a single successor"
accept UC-E3-4 "a ship at the top tier is offered nothing"
because UC-E3-4 "a choice of two is what makes the tree a tree rather than a ladder"
instead UC-E3-4 "one successor per tier, which would make the path fixed"
usecase UC-E3-5 "Taking the next ship hands over an un-upgraded one" status=HAVE
ground UC-E3-5 "tier up"
ground UC-E3-5 tier
requires UC-E3-5 S:tier_offered
establishes UC-E3-5 S:ship_better
includes E3 UC-E3-5
accept UC-E3-5 "after trading up, every statistic reads its base value"
accept UC-E3-5 "the new hull is stronger at base than the old one was fully upgraded, or the trade is never worth taking"
because UC-E3-5 "paying the whole hold and losing every upgrade is the cost that makes holding out a decision"
instead UC-E3-5 "carrying upgrades across the tier, which would make trading up strictly free"

The sources describe a cost chain: shields absorb, and past them damage knocks crystals out of the hold for anyone to take, and past that the ship dies back to tier one with nothing.
usecase UC-E4-1 "Pilot trades fire with another ship" status=HAVE
ground UC-E4-1 weapons
ground UC-E4-1 fire
requires UC-E4-1 S:in_field
establishes UC-E4-1 S:trading_fire
includes E4 UC-E4-1
state S:trading_fire "shots are being exchanged"
accept UC-E4-1 "lasers, torpedoes and special weapons are all available routes to damage"
usecase UC-E4-2 "Shields absorb before the hold does" status=HAVE
ground UC-E4-2 shield
requires UC-E4-2 S:trading_fire
establishes UC-E4-2 S:shield_down
includes E4 UC-E4-2
state S:shield_down "the shield is depleted"
accept UC-E4-2 "no crystals are lost while the shield still has charge"
usecase UC-E4-3 "Damage past the shield knocks crystals loose" status=HAVE
ground UC-E4-3 "gems as shield"
requires UC-E4-3 S:shield_down
establishes UC-E4-3 S:bleeding_gems
includes E4 UC-E4-3
state S:bleeding_gems "the pilot is losing crystals to incoming fire"
accept UC-E4-3 "with the shield down, damage taken removes that amount of crystals from the hold"
accept UC-E4-3 "crystals knocked loose are collectable by anyone, including the attacker"
because UC-E4-3 "crystals acting as a second shield is what makes a full hold dangerous to carry"
instead UC-E4-3 "the hold being safe until death, which would make hoarding free"
usecase UC-E4-4 "A ship that runs out of everything dies" status=HAVE
ground UC-E4-4 death
requires UC-E4-4 S:bleeding_gems
establishes UC-E4-4 S:ship_destroyed
includes E4 UC-E4-4
state S:ship_destroyed "the pilot's ship is destroyed"
accept UC-E4-4 "a destroyed ship leaves the field"
usecase UC-E4-5 "Death returns the pilot to tier one with nothing" status=HAVE
ground UC-E4-5 death
ground UC-E4-5 tier
requires UC-E4-5 S:ship_destroyed
establishes UC-E4-5 S:back_at_tier_one
includes E4 UC-E4-5
accept UC-E4-5 "the respawned ship is tier one regardless of the tier that died"
accept UC-E4-5 "every upgrade bought before death is gone"
accept UC-E4-5 "the respawned pilot holds minimal crystals, not none and not the hold they had"

Survival ends by squeezing the field rather than by a timer. The sources give the mechanism, the warnings, and the ending condition as three separate claims.
usecase UC-E5-1 "A repulsive field grows out from the star" status=HAVE
ground UC-E5-1 "gravity field"
requires UC-E5-1 S:in_field
establishes UC-E5-1 S:field_closing
includes E5 UC-E5-1
state S:field_closing "the playable area is shrinking"
accept UC-E5-1 "the field pushes players away from the star rather than pulling them in"
accept UC-E5-1 "the field grows larger and stronger as the endgame progresses"
because UC-E5-1 "a shrinking field forces contact without a timer deciding the round"
instead UC-E5-1 "a round timer, which would end the game without anyone having to fight"
usecase UC-E5-2 "The field warns before it reaches a player" status=HAVE
ground UC-E5-2 "endgame warning"
requires UC-E5-2 S:field_closing
establishes UC-E5-2 S:warned
includes E5 UC-E5-2
state S:warned "players know how much room is left"
accept UC-E5-2 "warnings are given at 75%, 50%, 25% and 0%"
because UC-E5-2 "a squeeze nobody can see coming is a death nobody can play around"
instead UC-E5-2 "a silent field, which would make position luck rather than choice"
usecase UC-E5-3 "The closing field forces players together" status=HAVE
ground UC-E5-3 "gravity field"
requires UC-E5-3 S:warned
establishes UC-E5-3 S:forced_together
includes E5 UC-E5-3
state S:forced_together "the survivors cannot avoid each other"
accept UC-E5-3 "the survivable area is smaller at the end of the round than at the start"
usecase UC-E5-4 "The last pilot alive takes the round" status=HAVE
ground UC-E5-4 "survival objective"
requires UC-E5-4 S:forced_together
establishes UC-E5-4 S:one_left
includes E5 UC-E5-4
state S:one_left "one pilot remains alive"
accept UC-E5-4 "victory is being last alive, not holding the highest count of anything"
usecase UC-E5-5 "The server ends the round" status=HAVE
ground UC-E5-5 "round end"
requires UC-E5-5 S:one_left
establishes UC-E5-5 S:round_decided
includes E5 UC-E5-5
accept UC-E5-5 "the server ends once one player is left"
